pack.name: Edge Spectrum: Line Capture
pack.description: Forward capture of public ESPN lines into an append-only archive, for closing-line-value analysis.

templates.name: Edge Spectrum: ESPN Line Capture
templates.description: Snapshots ESPN's public scoreboard for NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL and appends one JSON line per game (spread, total, moneyline, scores) to <output>/<SPORT>/<day>.jsonl, labelling each pre-game capture open, midday or close for closing-line-value analysis. Append-only, no keys. Needs Node 18+ and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/.

parameters.label: edge-spectrum clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-spectrum, with `npm ci` run in its site/ folder.

parameters.label: Line archive folder
parameters.help: Where the JSONL files go. Files are only ever appended to.

parameters.label: Hours between runs
parameters.help: Match it to the schedule: a capture within this many hours of the start is labelled close.

templates.author: ai-automation-tools
